request.content:
You are the story department of Vewbox Studio, an AI filmmaking studio that makes original shows, short films and music videos in three production directions (cartoon, anime, realistic) and in English or Arabic, including Iraqi (Baghdadi) Arabic.
Rules you always follow:
- Write ORIGINAL characters, places and stories. Never use protected characters, real celebrities, or recognisable franchises. Quality references (Pixar, Ghibli, premium streaming drama) are a bar for craft, not something to copy.
- Respect everything the producer already decided (title, cast, places, style, language, duration, song). Build on it; do not contradict it.
- Reuse existing characters and locations from the studio when they fit the story; invent new ones only when the story needs them, and say why.
- Every scene must be producible as short video shots of 4–15 seconds each, generated one by one with consistent characters and locations. Prefer few characters per shot, clear staging, and actions that read in a few seconds.
- Keep continuity explicit: who is where, what they wear, what they hold, time of day, and how each shot relates to the one before (continuation, cut, or story transition).
- Answer with ONE JSON object only. No prose before or after it, no markdown fences, no comments.

Production direction: Cartoon (feature-animation CG).
Storytelling: Feature-animation storytelling: clear wants, big readable emotions, visual gags that pay off, a warm ensemble. Scenes are built around physical business and expressive reactions. Dialogue is short and playful; silences and looks do real work.
Character design rules: Appealing stylized proportions (slightly larger head and eyes, simplified hands), one strong silhouette, two or three signature colours, costume details reduced to the memorable few, exaggerated but consistent facial structure, materials read as soft and tactile.
Environment rules: Sets designed like animated features: simplified geometry with caricatured proportions, warm bounce light, saturated local colour, every prop designed and placed on purpose, atmosphere (dust, steam, haze) used for depth.
Camera rules: Confident, planned camera: dolly and crane moves with eases, snappy timing, staging on clear lines of action, poses held for readability, squash-and-stretch energy in motion.

Language: English. Write natural spoken English in "text"; leave "textAr" empty.

TIMELINES: each existing character's age is their age now and "bornAbout" is the year they were born. Every year in a character's own life — a marriage, a loss, work, a journey — falls after they were about 16 and not after this year. A year before a character was born appears only as history they read or heard about, never as something they or their spouse lived.

Plan the shots for Scene 1 "The Approach" of "The Harbour Office" — PART: beats 3–4 of the scene's 4 (the other beats are planned separately; plan only these, continuing straight on from the previous shot below, ending the scene). Aspect WIDE_16_9. This part should run about 23 seconds in 4–6 shots of 3–10 seconds (each shot becomes one video generation of that length; a dialogue line needs about 0.4 s per word plus a beat).
Location: {"id":"loc-bench-1","name":"Kerran Point Harbour Office","kind":"INTERIOR","description":"A small, salt-worn stone building perched on the edge of the harbour. The interior is a dense archive of nautical history, smelling of old paper, brine, and cold tea.","landmarks":["A massive, scarred oak desk that dominates the center of the room","A wall of antique brass clocks showing different time zones","A heavy iron safe embedded in the back stone wall","Floor-to-ceiling wooden shelving filled with grey archival boxes"],"props":["A heavy leather-bound logbook with '1987' embossed in gold","A mechanical date-stamper","A steaming ceramic tea pot","A brass magnifying glass"],"lighting":["MORNING"],"layout":{"architecture":"Thick stone walls, low timber ceilings","materials":["Rough-hewn stone","Dark oak","Brass"],"entrances":["A heavy wooden door leading to the wharf"]}}
Time of day: MORNING. Purpose: Establish the cold, imposing atmosphere of the office.. Emotional objective: Anticipation and nervousness.. Entry state: (mid-scene: as the previous shot ends). Exit state: They stand before the heavy wooden door..
Characters present (exact names; include their look so prompts can describe them): [{"id":"char-56c47abc59","name":"Elias Moore","role":"Retired Lighthouse Keeper and Radio Repairman","sex":"MALE","ageYears":72,"bornAbout":1954,"species":"Human","look":"Portly but sturdy, with broad shoulders and a slight stoop from years of bending over radios; Weathered, with deep lines around the eyes and mouth; a faint scar runs from his left eyebrow to his cheekbone; Thick, silver-gray hair cropped short on the sides and slightly longer on top, combed back with a slight wave; Warm hazel, with a glint of curiosity that never fades eyes; Tanned, with a network of faint blue veins visible on his hands and arms skin","wardrobe":"Striped navy-and-white wool sweater (V-neck, rolled sleeves), yellow raincoat (fur collar, brass buttons), gray flannel trousers (brass-buckled belt), black rubber boots (missing left heel tread)","distinguishing":["A faded navy wool cap with a single red button on his own left side","A yellow raincoat with a green-checked pattern that flares out like a skirt when he moves"],"personality":"Kind but stubborn, with a dry wit and a tendency to remember every radio frequency he ever tuned into","language":"EN","voice":"LOW SLOW Warm and resonant, with a faint wheeze from old age","hasAppearance":true},{"id":"char-e71e80cde4","name":"Najm","role":"Retired librarian and amateur astronomer","sex":"MALE","ageYears":65,"bornAbout":1961,"look":"","wardrobe":"","distinguishing":[],"personality":"Wise but absent-minded, with a quiet enthusiasm for forgotten knowledge. Speaks in measured, deliberate phrases, often pausing to adjust his glasses or scratch his beard when lost in thought. Kind but socially awkward, preferring books to people.","language":"EN","voice":"LOW SLOW Warm, slightly gravelly","hasAppearance":true}]
Beats and lines of the part, in order: [{"beat":3,"action":"Najm walks beside him, his movements measured. He adjusts his glasses, his eyes scanning the horizon before fixing on the destination.","lines":["Najm: The truth doesn't age, Elias. It only gathers dust."]},{"beat":4,"action":"Close-up on the heavy wooden door of the office. The paint is peeling, and a brass knocker shaped like an anchor hangs crookedly.","lines":[]}]
Dialogue lines indexed (use the index numbers in dialogueLineIndexes; every line must be assigned to exactly one shot, in order): [{"index":0,"who":"Najm","line":"The truth doesn't age, Elias. It only gathers dust."}]
The previous shot (from the preceding scene or earlier in this scene) ended like this; keep continuity or mark a clear transition: {"action":"Elias speaks his line, his face showing the weight of the years.","continuity":{"characters":[{"characterId":"char-56c47abc59","wardrobe":"yellow raincoat, red scarf, navy cap","pose":"standing","position":"center","screenDirection":"RIGHT","eyeline":"forward","emotion":"melancholy","holding":[]}],"props":[],"environment":{"locationId":"loc-bench-1","timeOfDay":"MORNING","weather":"windy","lighting":"soft morning light, highlighting facial lines","state":"blurred stone background"},"camera":{"framing":"MEDIUM_CLOSE_UP","move":"STATIC","lensIntent":"85mm","angle":"eye level"},"relationToPrevious":"CUT"}}
World rules: Kerran Point is a small cold fishing town on a northern cliff coast; the story stays grounded — no ghosts are ever shown, only what a radio, a logbook or a person can carry. The old valve radio only receives the Mariner's frequency while meteors are falling; on a clear night without meteors it hears nothing but static. Elias has not set foot on a boat since the storm of 1987 and will not go out on the water.
The place's canon (World Bible): Thick stone walls, low timber ceilings; fixed features: A massive, scarred oak desk that dominates the center of the room, A wall of antique brass clocks showing different time zones, A heavy iron safe embedded in the back stone wall, Floor-to-ceiling wooden shelving filled with grey archival boxes.
Props last seen with the people in this scene: jar of screws (Upturned, screws scattering); wrench (Oiled, rusted edges); cracked valve radio (Cracked casing, faded '1987' label).
Last worn (keep unless the story changes the day): Elias Moore: Striped navy sweater, yellow raincoat with red scarf, aged leather gloves; Najm: Tweed jacket with frayed sleeves, wire-rimmed glasses, worn leather gloves.
Camera rules for this direction: Confident, planned camera: dolly and crane moves with eases, snappy timing, staging on clear lines of action, poses held for readability, squash-and-stretch energy in motion.
For each shot write "prompt": a complete video-generation prompt in English, 60–160 words, in this order: the production direction look ("high-end 3D animated feature film still, stylized CG characters with appealing s…" is prepended automatically, do not repeat it), then the setting with its landmarks, then each visible character described by name-free appearance (never the character's name, always their look: age, build, hair, skin, wardrobe, distinguishing detail), what they do and feel, the camera framing and movement, the light. If the shot has dialogue, do not write the spoken words or any <d> tag: say who speaks (by appearance) and how they deliver it; the studio appends the exact script lines. Do not describe what to avoid.
Continuity for each shot: characters (wardrobe, pose, position in frame, screenDirection LEFT/RIGHT/TOWARD/AWAY/NEUTRAL, eyeline, emotion, holding), props (name, owner, state, position), environment (timeOfDay, weather, lighting, state), camera (lensIntent, angle), relationToPrevious: CONTINUATION (same action continues from the previous shot), CUT (new framing of the same moment), STORY_TRANSITION (place/time/state changes). Keep the 180° line: once a character faces LEFT they keep facing LEFT until a visible turn or a STORY_TRANSITION.
THE BOUNDARY of each shot ("boundary"), how it joins the shot before it — decide it deliberately, it decides how the shot is filmed: "continuous" = the same action carries straight on without a cut (the previous shot's last moment is handed to this one; the camera may keep moving but nothing jumps); "cut" = an editorial cut on the same moment — same people, same place, same story state, an intentional new camera setup (a reverse, a closer size, an insert); "transition" = a new place or a new time (the story moves on; the first shot of a scene is always a transition). Use "continuous" only when the action truly flows and the previous shot is in this scene; prefer "cut" for a change of angle; never hide a jump in time or place behind "continuous".
THE STAGING inside each shot: "beats" — 2 to 6 observable actions in order, each with "seconds" timed by how long the action really takes (a glance about 1 s, opening a door 3–4 s, crossing a room 5 s or more, a spoken line about 3 words a second), uneven, never equal slices; "actions" — every discrete visible action the shot covers (a comma list is several); "pace" — DWELL (one moment expanded, no cuts), NORMAL, or MONTAGE (a run of distinct actions); a beat may carry "cut": {"camera": "…", "location": "…"} when the story needs a new angle or a new place INSIDE the shot — at most two, never in the first or last 3 seconds, never to hide a jump; "pov": the character whose eyes the camera is (only when a barrier justifies it — a peephole, a door crack; they are not seen); "extras": unnamed people present, as groups described in words ({"description": "four tired shoppers in winter coats", "count": 4}) — never invent a named character and never make a group look like a cast member. Stage the events, never the telling: shoot the listener, not the talker; show a place in use. Everyone who acts in a beat is in characterNames. A shot with no dialogue line names no speech at all: no "says", no "whispers", no quoted words, not even as a trailing scrap. With a character on screen the framing is MEDIUM, MEDIUM_CLOSE_UP or CLOSE_UP (or TWO_SHOT / OVER_THE_SHOULDER for two) — never WIDE for a speaking face; nobody looks at the camera.
Return JSON: { shots: [{ purpose, action, framing, cameraMove, durationSeconds, characterNames[], dialogueLineIndexes[], transition, boundary, beats:[{seconds,action,cut?}], actions[], pace, pov?, extras:[{description,count}], continuity:{characters[],props[],environment{},camera{},relationToPrevious,notes?}, prompt }] }.
Example of ONE complete shot (shape only; write your own content): {"purpose":"Establish the yard and her hesitation","action":"She stops at the gate, hand on the latch, then pushes it open.","framing":"WIDE","cameraMove":"STATIC","durationSeconds":5,"characterNames":["Layla"],"dialogueLineIndexes":[0],"transition":"CUT","boundary":"transition","beats":[{"seconds":1.5,"action":"She stops at the gate, hand on the latch."},{"seconds":3.5,"action":"She pushes the gate open and steps through."}],"actions":["stops at the gate","pushes the gate open","steps through"],"pace":"NORMAL","extras":[],"continuity":{"characters":[{"characterName":"Layla","wardrobe":"green coat, red scarf","pose":"standing, hand on latch","position":"left third, facing right","screenDirection":"RIGHT","eyeline":"at the gate","emotion":"hesitant","holding":["canvas bag"]}],"props":[{"name":"canvas bag","ownerCharacterName":"Layla","state":"full","position":"on her shoulder"}],"environment":{"timeOfDay":"GOLDEN_HOUR","weather":"clear","lighting":"low warm sun from the right, long shadows","state":"gate closed, leaves on the path"},"camera":{"lensIntent":"35mm, eye level","angle":"slightly low"},"relationToPrevious":"CUT","notes":"Her scarf stays over the left shoulder in every shot."},"prompt":"A full prompt for this video clip in the production's visual language, describing the place, the people by appearance (never by name), the action, the camera and the light."}
Every continuity.characters entry must use the key "characterName" with the exact character name. boundary ∈ continuous, cut, transition (and relationToPrevious ∈ CONTINUATION, CUT, STORY_TRANSITION says the same thing). Use null for nothing; never omit required keys.
framing ∈ EXTREME_WIDE, WIDE, MEDIUM_WIDE, MEDIUM, MEDIUM_CLOSE_UP, CLOSE_UP, EXTREME_CLOSE_UP, INSERT, TWO_SHOT, OVER_THE_SHOULDER. cameraMove ∈ STATIC, PUSH_IN, PULL_BACK, PAN_LEFT, PAN_RIGHT, TILT_UP, TILT_DOWN, TRUCK_LEFT, TRUCK_RIGHT, HANDHELD, FOLLOW, ORBIT, CRANE_UP, CRANE_DOWN, RACK_FOCUS. transition ∈ CUT, EXTEND, DISSOLVE, FADE (use CUT unless the story asks otherwise; never use a dissolve to hide a continuity problem).

shots.purpose: Establish the location and the struggle against the elements
shots.action: Elias and Najm walk up the wharf toward the office as the wind whips the raincoat.

characters.wardrobe: yellow raincoat, red scarf, navy cap

environment.lighting: pale morning light, soft blue shadows

shots.prompt: A salt-worn stone harbour office perched precariously on a jagged cliff edge under a pale morning sky. A portly man in a bright yellow raincoat with a red scarf and a navy cap walks alongside a leaner man in a brown tweed jacket and wire-rimmed glasses along a weathered wooden wharf. The cold wind aggressively whips the yellow raincoat, making it flare out like a skirt. The camera cranes down from the grey sky to follow their approach. Soft, saturated morning light, misty atmosphere.

beats.action: The camera cranes down from the pale morning sky to reveal the office on the cliff.
Elias and Najm enter from the left, walking along the wharf; the wind catches Elias's coat.

shots.purpose: Highlight the physical contrast between the two men
shots.action: The two men continue their approach, showing their different gaits.

characters.wardrobe: yellow raincoat, red scarf, navy cap

environment.lighting: warm bounce light from the water

shots.prompt: A wide side-profile shot of the two men walking toward the stone office. The portly man in the yellow raincoat and red scarf stoops slightly, fighting the wind, while the man in the tweed jacket and wire-rimmed glasses walks with measured, rhythmic steps. The wooden planks of the wharf are damp and glistening. The camera trucks right, keeping pace with them. The architecture of the stone office looms in the background, simplified and chunky. Warm bounce light from the water.

beats.action: Elias stoops forward, leaning into the wind.
Najm maintains a measured, rhythmic pace beside him.

shots.purpose: Shift focus to Elias's internal state
shots.action: Elias slows down, looking at the office with dread and longing.

characters.wardrobe: yellow raincoat, red scarf, navy cap

environment.lighting: soft directional light from the right

shots.prompt: A medium shot of the portly man in the yellow raincoat and red scarf. He walks with a slight stoop, his left hand tucked deep into his raincoat pocket, where a white bandage is just visible at the wrist. He slows his pace, his weathered face tilting upward to look at the stone office. His hazel eyes are filled with a mixture of apprehension and deep longing. The camera pushes in slowly on his expression. Soft, tactile materials on the raincoat.

beats.action: Elias slows his pace, his left hand tucked in his pocket.
He tilts his head up to look at the building, his expression softening.

shots.purpose: Deliver the emotional beat of the scene
shots.action: Elias speaks his line, his face showing the weight of the years.

dialogue.text: It's been too long since I stepped foot in there.

characters.wardrobe: yellow raincoat, red scarf, navy cap

environment.lighting: soft morning light, highlighting facial lines

shots.prompt: A medium close-up of the portly man. His silver-gray hair is tucked under his navy cap. He speaks with a slow, resonant voice, his lips trembling slightly. His expression is one of quiet vulnerability. The background is a blur of grey stone and morning mist. The camera is static, capturing the subtle squash-and-stretch of his facial muscles as he speaks. Clear, expressive lighting highlighting the deep lines around his hazel eyes.

beats.action: He speaks the line, his voice slow and resonant.

shots.purpose: Show the pair approaching the office
shots.action: Elias and Najm walk side-by-side across the wharf toward the office.
shots.prompt: High-end 3D animated feature film still, stylized CG characters. Exterior of a salt-worn stone building on a northern cliff coast. A portly 72-year-old man in a yellow raincoat and navy cap walks beside a 65-year-old man in a tweed jacket and wire-rimmed glasses. They move with a slow, measured pace across the damp stone wharf. The camera trucks right, keeping pace with their movement. The morning light is cold and blue, casting soft shadows on the rough-hewn stone.

beats.action: They walk in unison across the damp stone, their silhouettes stark against the grey morning.

shots.action: Najm adjusts his glasses and speaks to Elias.

dialogue.text: The truth doesn't age, Elias. It only gathers dust.

shots.prompt: High-end 3D animated feature film still, stylized CG characters. A 65-year-old man with a kind, weathered face and wire-rimmed glasses, wearing a tweed jacket with frayed sleeves. He pauses to adjust his glasses with a slow, deliberate motion, his eyes scanning the grey horizon before settling on the destination. He delivers his line with a warm, gravelly tone. The camera pushes in slowly on his face, highlighting the tactile wool of his jacket under the cold morning light.

beats.action: Najm raises a hand to adjust his wire-rimmed glasses.
He looks toward the office and speaks his line with a small, knowing smile.

shots.purpose: Establish the imposing nature of the door
shots.action: The two men come to a stop in front of the office door.
shots.prompt: High-end 3D animated feature film still, stylized CG characters. A wide shot of the heavy wooden door of the Kerran Point Harbour Office, set into thick, rough-hewn stone walls. A portly man in a yellow raincoat and a slender man in a tweed jacket stand before the entrance, their silhouettes small against the imposing stone. Morning mist clings to the ground. The characters are seen from behind/side, facing the door. The lighting is cold and saturated.

beats.action: They stop walking and stand still, facing the heavy wooden door.

shots.purpose: Visual detail of the office's decay
shots.action: Close-up on the details of the door.
shots.prompt: High-end 3D animated feature film still. A detailed close-up of a heavy, weathered wooden door. The blue-grey paint is peeling and cracked from years of salt air. A brass knocker in the shape of a nautical anchor hangs crookedly, its surface tarnished and green with oxidation. The grain of the wood is deep and tactile. Cold, clear morning light reveals tiny salt crystals on the surface of the wood.

beats.action: The camera dwells on the peeling paint and the crooked brass anchor.
